status: proposal only, not current DTO or native capability

sourceOwnerContract.characters: exact actual DOM textContent including whitespace
sourceOwnerContract.runs: contiguous current supported textRuns with exact source UTF-16 boundaries
sourceOwnerContract.inlineBoxes: separate exact source-owned ranges; no injected characters

sourceInlineBoxes.start: UTF-16 DOM boundary, allows start=end only actual empty element

sourceStyle.font: actual resolved source declaration with explicit native readiness
sourceStyle.background: typed COLOR source expression, no equal-value alias selection
sourceStyle.paddingInlineStart: finite nonnegative FLOAT or guarded actual literal
sourceStyle.paddingInlineEnd: finite nonnegative FLOAT or guarded actual literal
sourceStyle.borderBottom: actual style DASHED, typed width/color, no invented cadence

sourceInlineBoxes.fragments: exact source client rectangles and owning logical text lines across every mode
sourceInlineBoxes.sourceTitle: actual ABBR HTML title, metadata only until functional support

preflight: Validate full source profile/owner copy/font/typed alias/mode/span/empty-box anatomy before asset or scene writes.
Require explicit supported native box-flow capability; background overlays alone do not establish source glyph placement.
Validate current main identity and real current-page linked instance owner relationship.
Reject changed owner characters/range formatting/sourcebox signature requiring reflow before permanent writes, with current-page-only scope.
Recheck after awaited font preparation before permanent import; temporary font probes journal separately.
editing: Initially immutable source line/box profile. Whole logical text edits require verified reflow or clear refusal; no independent editable visual fragments.
nativeFeasibilityGate: Current native rich API does not provide inline padding/box-flow. Do not assume per-range background or distribute letterSpacing to simulate padding.
generatedContentFollowon: UA Q/list marker ink must derive actual locale browser behavior separately; no guessed glyphs.
